faqs.answer: Your wallet may not be connected, or the dashboard may still be syncing blockchain data. Verify that the correct wallet and network are selected.
faqs.question: Why is my wallet balance not showing?

faqs.answer: Market data is refreshed automatically using the configured data provider. Update frequency depends on the source and network availability.
faqs.question: How often is FLR price updated?

faqs.answer: Ensure your WFLR is delegated and that the epoch is eligible for rewards. Some rewards may require claiming after distribution.
faqs.question: Why am I not receiving rewards?

faqs.answer: Support depends on the integrations available in the dashboard. Compatible Flare wallets can be connected when supported.
faqs.question: What wallets are supported?

faqs.answer: Navigate to the wallet section and select Disconnect. This only removes the dashboard session and does not affect your funds.
faqs.question: How do I disconnect my wallet?
